items.name: Burot
items.observations: Upright branching reddish-brown stems, alternate strongly pinnatifid pointed dark green leaves, clearly exposed woolly white-silver leaf undersides, airy pyramidal clusters of inconspicuous greenish brown flower heads, robust fibrous root/rhizome crown. Characteristic mugwort traits are represented without a conspicuous large flower.
items.limitations: Some leaf segments are more fern-like and regular than specimens in nature, and individual inflorescences are enlarged for readability. Roots are illustrative rather than an anatomical reconstruction of the underground rhizome system. This image is a visual field-guide aid, not conclusive identification. Burot pollen is allergenic.
